text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe— 
The time has finally come for a Japanese 
Umamusume to challenge the pinnacle of the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The members of "Project L'Arc," who had 
worked tirelessly together up to this 
point, watched on with bated breath.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fresh off a dominant victory in her 
previous race, Venus Park steps into the 
paddock. Deafening cheers rain down upon 
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the one to fulfill that 
long-cherished wish... the one to seize 
victory is <chrname>. With that, she is sent off to 
the stage that decides the world's best—
